description.narrative: The hepatitis B “birth dose” protects newborns from chronic, liver-killing infection. Gavi’s support covers procurement of vaccine and associated supplies such as injection safety devices, vaccine introduction grants, or technical assistance to help countries develop their plans to introduce the vaccine and develop their applications for Gavi.

This activity details our work on Hepatitis B Birth Dose in Sudan (the) through the provision of budget and transaction data. We also provide the relevant documents that guide these activities, which are the support request proposal(s) provided by the Government of Sudan (the), as well as the decision letter(s) issued by Gavi, for progress. These documents describe the activities, the objectives as well as the beneficiaries.
